name: smoke_10x32
caption: Wave 2 NF4 smoke: 32 new tokens × 10 Paper B checkpoints. Shows load class, Hub revision, peak VRAM, decode tok/s, fill, stop, thinking. Does not measure G_t, lock, or 12W occupancy.
alt_text: Wave 2 NF4 smoke: 32 new tokens × 10 Paper B checkpoints. Shows load class, Hub revision, peak VRAM, decode tok/s, fill, stop, thinking. Does not measure G_t, lock, or 12W occupancy.
limitations: Smoke is T=32 / W=32, not a 12W scientific horizon. tok/s on smoke includes a tiny decode and is not the S9 operating point. UMAP is not used. No G_t or lock claim.
